research.description: Validated historical/model artifacts remain immutable repository assets so VMEWS research can be reproduced without asking an LLM to synthesize historical prices.
research.availability: Existing point-in-time snapshots, model files and research datasets remain local project inputs.

live.policy: Gemini is the single external provider for new live market/news/context requests. Other public live adapters are legacy code and must not be scheduled once this migration is enabled.
live.historicalPolicy: Do not use Gemini to fabricate long OHLCV history. Historical research/model inputs are served from versioned repository artifacts.
